names.note: Read out of saint.gr's line for 19 Νοεμβρίου, «Άγιος Άζης ο Θαυματουργός», with the rank word left off; the epithet «ο Θαυματουργός» is left out of the stored form because the folder's `types` carry it.

Read out of the title on the name link behind his place in the line for 19 ноября ст. ст., «Аза Исаврийский, мч.», with the rank word left off; the line itself declines the forename and gives no epithet. `.tmp/foldchk.py` reports no folder holding this form.

floruit.note: The interval is widened to the reign the source names, and neither reading is narrowed. saint.gr gave this folder a floruit of «about 289»; days.pravoslavie.ru closes his line for 19 ноября ст. ст. with «(284-305)» and its life page puts the martyrdom «при императоре Диоклитиане (284 - 305)». Neither page gives a year of birth or of death.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 19 ноября ст. ст. — «Мч. Азы и с ним 150-ти воинов (284-305).»

source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 19ης Νοεμβρίου — «Άγιος Άζης ο Θαυματουργός»

attestations.note: The life page `https://www.saint.gr/2904/saint.aspx` heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 19 Νοεμβρίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. **This is not the corpus's `azes`**, which carries a venerated Greek row on 21 October from `https://www.saint.gr/2555/saint.aspx`: that page's whole narrative is «Ο Άγιος Άζης μαρτύρησε διά πυρός», martyred by fire, with no country, no year and no emperor, while this one is an Isaurian soldier turned desert-dweller under Diocletian, beheaded by the eparch Aquilinus, with a hundred and fifty soldiers, twelve more and the eparch's own wife and daughter converted through him. Two entries on one calendar are two commemorations, so two men; the 21 October row is left exactly where it is. No hymn on this page. No asterisk and not the sentence «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη η ύπαρξη του Αγίου».
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue as printed by pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding Julian day (2 October 2026).
